photos.title: Margate Tower from above
photos.what: Margate Tower from above (USDA NAIP aerial photo, 2023): the tall oceanfront tower with a stepped orange-trimmed roof stands at the label; a long parking deck and a second tower stand to its north-east; the beach and the Atlantic Ocean run along the right. Labels placed from coordinates (labels.json).
photos.caption: Margate Tower from above, on the oceanfront at Kingston Plantation.
photos.alt: Aerial photo of the Margate Tower oceanfront tower at Kingston Plantation in Myrtle Beach, labelled, with the beach and the Atlantic Ocean to the east
photos.author: USDA Farm Service Agency, NAIP
photos.provenance: U.S. government aerial photo: USDA National Agriculture Imagery Program (NAIP), South Carolina 2023, natural color, 60 cm. Exported by Chapter3 from the USGS National Map NAIP image service (exportImage, Web Mercator, cubic resampling, mosaic locked to Year=2023) on 2026-11-17; the exact request is in source_request.

photos.subject_check: Looked at full size by the writer of /invest/condo-buildings/margate-tower/ on 2026-11-17. The label sits on the stepped tower (long shadow to the north-west); the parking deck and a second tower stand to the north-east; the beach and the Atlantic Ocean are on the right. No person; no readable sign, plate or house number at page size.
